title: 1996 Topps X-Files Season 2 #62 One Breath Trading Card
descriptionText: The product is a 1996 Topps The X-Files Season Two trading card featuring an episode where Fox Mulder comforts a despairing character. This non-sport trading card is part of the set manufactured by Topps in 1996. The card is not autographed and does not have any memorabilia attached to it. It is labeled as card number 62 in the set and is focused on the popular TV franchise The X-Files.
